name: KNSCHA-rvt_RVT220UF16V67RV0015
manufacturer: KNSCHA (Guangdong KNSCHA Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.)
title: 220 µF 16 V surface-mount aluminium electrolytic capacitor, RVT general-purpose series
summary: RVT220UF16V67RV0015 is a 220 µF, 16 V DC aluminium electrolytic capacitor in a 6.3 mm diameter by 7.7 mm tall can on a plastic base for surface mounting. It is rated for -55 to +105 °C with a 2000 hour life at +105 °C under rated voltage, 120 mA ripple at 120 Hz and +105 °C, and ±20 % capacitance tolerance. It ships on embossed carrier tape, 1,000 per reel.

pins.function: Anode terminal. It is the lead on the side of the base with the two cut corners.

pins.name: Negative
pins.function: Cathode terminal. The top of the can carries a dark band on this side to mark polarity.

operation.text: With a soldering iron, unless a specification says otherwise, solder at 350±5 ℃ and finish within 3±1 seconds.

Reflow within the temperatures and times listed under reflow soldering conditions. A hotter profile calls for measuring the capacitor body temperature and the oven settings and reporting them to KNSCHA. Larger cans heat more slowly, so the oven need not be set per size: Φ4 and Φ10 parts can both be mounted on a PCB and reflowed with the same oven settings.

operation.topic: What sets the part's temperature in reflow
operation.text: A larger can warms more slowly. A part near the middle of the board runs cooler than one near its edge. A larger or thicker board warms more slowly.
One reflow pass is preferred. Where a second pass cannot be avoided, the temperatures and times of both passes are measured and reported to KNSCHA. A third pass is not allowed.
The part is polarised. The dark band on the top of the can marks the negative side; the cut corners of the base mark the positive side.
